Keylime registrar does not reject same UUID from different TPM#1820

Description

4N0body5
opened on Nov 24, 2025

Issue body actions

Environment

OS / version: Fedora 44

Processor architecture: x86_64

TPM Manufacturer: SWTPM

Keylime version:

keylime-base-7.13.0-2.fc44.noarch

keylime-registrar-7.13.0-2.fc44.noarch

keylime-tenant-7.13.0-2.fc44.noarch

keylime-tools-7.13.0-2.fc44.noarch

keylime-verifier-7.13.0-2.fc44.noarch

keylime-agent-rust-0.2.8-8.fc44.x86_64

keylime-agent-rust-common-0.2.8-8.fc44.noarch

keylime-agent-rust-ima-emulator-0.2.8-8.fc44.x86_64

Description

The Keylime registrar allows registration of another agent (different TPM device, different EK certificate) with a duplicate UUID.

This presents a critical security vulnerability that allows an attacker to take over an existing agent's identity by re-registering with the same UUID though a different TPM's EK certificate.

Expected behavior:

When another agent attempts to register with a UUID that already exists in the registrar, but with a different EK certificate, the registrar should:

Reject the registration with HTTP 403 Forbidden

Log a security warning about the duplicate UUID attempt from different TPM

Not update the existing agent record

Actual behavior

Currently the registrar does not validate that the EK certificate on device using duplicate UUID matches the previously registered one. But it allows another TPM device with a different EK but duplicate UUID to proceed with a valid registration, without any error or warnings.

Steps to reproduce problem

Setup keylime registrar, verifier and two (emulated) TPM devices - /dev/tpm0 and /dev/tpm1

Register first agent with UUID d432fbb3-d2f1-4a97-9ef7-75bd81c00000 using /dev/tpm0 (IP: 172.18.0.4)

Attempt to register second agent with the same UUID d432fbb3-d2f1-4a97-9ef7-75bd81c00000 but using /dev/tpm1 (IP: 172.18.0.8)

Observe the registration succeeds even though it shoul fail with 403 Forbidden

See test reproducer: https://github.com/RedHat-SP-Security/keylime-tests/blob/de4807f14a7dbd67f009e4d0171b6cf1a3a1a946/container/functional/registrar_rejecting_duplicate_uuid/test.sh
